scope: Web authentication, child/text records, account isolation, page-memory drafts and reopen/restart persistence

checks.webExport: Passed by Web implementation agent; no dependency versions changed

webAcceptance.data: Synthetic example.test accounts only; no personal browser profile, screenshots, traces or credentials saved
webAcceptance.cleanup: Only runner-owned Node and browser processes stopped; synthetic database rows retained

findings: Cookie account switch between preflight and create-child could persist the old account draft under the new account
Cancelled old-child identity check could gate and cancel the new-child view
fixes: Both write requests carry expected user ID; server compares it with actual session before storage and rejects missing/mismatched values with 428/409
Cancelled identity checks are ignored on both success and failure
review.regressionTests: Public server precondition and client state/transport cases passed
review.closeOut: Independent Astra Max re-review closed both findings; no remaining blocker in reviewed scope

failuresAndDecisions.failure: Local antivirus injected an external script into the test page and triggered the no-external-request assertion.
failuresAndDecisions.resolution: Keep blocking the identified Kaspersky origin; exclude only that known environmental injection from product-request failure. All other external origins still fail. No antivirus/security setting changed.

limitations: Latest 100 records per child only; full timeline/search deferred to P2
No automatic write retry or full S07 opId protocol
No persistent browser business data or offline outbox
No Android, Gemini, external email, deployment, backup/recovery or independent teammate acceptance
Prompt Pack draft was not adopted
nextGate: Merge reviewed S03-W01 before starting S06-W01 or S09-W01
